items.title: Scrubbit 0.6.6
items.description: Command-line fixes: install now works on Apple Silicon Macs, and scrubbing a file no longer crashes.
bullets: Fixed: the scrubbit command line now installs on Apple Silicon Macs
Fixed: scrubbing a PDF or other file from the command line no longer crashes
Clearer command-line help for file paths with spaces

items.title: Scrubbit 0.6.0
items.description: A command-line tool, a new background engine, and a big reliability pass.
bullets: New: a scrubbit command-line tool for scripts and AI agents
Scrubbit's core now runs as its own background program on your computer
Redesigned Decode page with inline highlighting
Keep entities from the glossary, and set default categories per project
Security hardening and many bug fixes
